summary: The eight ESP-IDF firmware files and the five apps' Jenkinsfiles are declarative files on espFirmware and modernApp.test, and IoTSupport's two files write the Keycloak settings inline (values read live). That is one unpushed commit in each of 13 /work/scratch clones on main, listed in the new migration-ledger.md (14 rows). All 14 files pass the controller's linter, and `kc project test --project root` is green; the done-record and close-out entry P4 are committed in AnsibleSpecs 05cb89e.
